About this tab
- **Calories / Protein / Carbohydrates / Total Fat** — the latest day's totals, relayed from Apple Health's generic nutrition catch-all. Carbs are shown as one field (not split simple/complex) — HealthKit has no native "complex carb" type.
- **Color coding**: Protein/Carbs/Fat are colored against the Institute of Medicine's Acceptable Macronutrient Distribution Range (AMDR) — Protein 10–35%, Carbs 45–65%, Fat 20–35% of total calories — green in range, amber near the edge, red well outside. **Calories** is colored against your own Daily Calorie Goal (green within 15%, amber within 30%) — and stays plain white with no goal set, since there's no reference to judge it against.
- **Daily Calorie Goal** — a separate intake target you can set on **Admin → People & Defaults** (distinct from the activity-burn Calorie goal used on Today/Activity).
- **Each day's number is a running total** re-sent as you log more through the day, not a per-meal log — logging a second item moves the day's total, it doesn't add a separate row.

- **If you log food in more than one app on the same day, the totals are ADDED together** (different apps are assumed to be different meals, not the same sensor reading twice — unlike steps/HR, which use the max across vendors). The source caption shows "via multiple sources" when this happens. **Caveat:** if the *same* meal was logged in two apps by mistake, this will double-count it — there's no way to detect that from this data.

**To get data here:** log food in a HealthKit-connected app (Cronometer's free tier is confirmed to work well; MyFitnessPal has been unreliable in testing), then in **Health Auto Export** make sure your **Health Metrics** automation includes Dietary Energy / Protein / Carbohydrates / Total Fat (or just "Select All").

*Not medical or dietary advice — for personal trend awareness only.*","backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.50)"}}},"layout":{"options":{},"tabs":{"items":[{"layoutId":"layout_1","label":"Nutrition"}]},"layoutDefinitions":{"layout_1":{"type":"absolute","options":{"width":1440,"height":1170,"display":"auto","backgroundImage":{"x":0,"y":0,"src":"/static/app/wearables/bg_health.svg","sizeType":"cover"}},"structure":[{"item":"intro_md","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":20,"w":1400,"h":100}},{"item":"cal_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":140,"w":220,"h":170}},{"item":"protein_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":250,"y":140,"w":220,"h":170}},{"item":"carbs_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":480,"y":140,"w":220,"h":170}},{"item":"fat_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":710,"y":140,"w":220,"h":170}},{"item":"goal_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":940,"y":140,"w":220,"h":170}},{"item":"nutrition_src","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":320,"w":1140,"h":40}},{"item":"cal_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":370,"w":1400,"h":280}},{"item":"macro_chart","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":670,"w":1400,"h":280}},{"item":"nutrition_empty","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":140,"w":1140,"h":100}},{"item":"guide_md","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":970,"w":1400,"h":180}}]}},"globalInputs":["input_global_trp","input_person"]}}
